SELECT agent_runs_1.run_id, agent_runs_1.session_id, agent_runs_1.created_at, agent_runs_1.updated_at, agent_runs_1.started_at, agent_runs_1.metadata[$1::TEXT] AS checkpoint_run_id, agent_runs_2.run_id AS run_id_1, agent_runs_2.task_id, agent_runs_2.status, agent_runs_2.interrupt, agent_runs_2.failure, agent_runs_2.agent_response, agent_runs_2.attempt_count, agent_runs_2.next_attempt_at, agent_runs_2.cancel_reason, agent_runs_2.cancel_requested_at, agent_runs_2.updated_at AS updated_at_1, agent_runs_2.completed_at, tasks.task_id AS task_id_1, tasks.status AS status_1, tasks.recovery_required, tasks.cancel_requested_at AS cancel_requested_at_1, tasks.updated_at AS updated_at_2, tasks.completed_at AS completed_at_1 
FROM agent_runs AS agent_runs_1 JOIN agent_runs AS agent_runs_2 ON agent_runs_2.run_id = (SELECT agent_runs.run_id 
FROM agent_runs 
WHERE agent_runs.public_run_id = agent_runs_1.run_id ORDER BY agent_runs.created_at DESC, agent_runs.run_id DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER) LEFT OUTER JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = agent_runs_2.task_id 
WHERE agent_runs_1.public_run_id = agent_runs_1.run_id AND agent_runs_1.run_id = (SELECT agent_runs.public_run_id 
FROM agent_runs 
WHERE agent_runs.run_id = $3::UUID AND agent_runs.session_id = $4::UUID) AND agent_runs_1.session_id = $5::UUID
